Because of this you need to be fit; your job is a physical role: you are on your feet all the time. The job as housekeeper is very intensive, but we make sure that the environment in which you will work will be pleasant! 
 What does your work consist of? 
 - Clean guest bedrooms according to the applicable standards - Making/Cleaning up the beds - Vacuuming carpets and mops hard floors - Dusting and cleaning furniture - Refilling amenities: coffee, tea, shampoo, soaps etc. - Filling the minibar - Manage guest requests in a timely and efficient manner 
 What we want from you 
 - Positive attitude - Good communication skills - Good command of the English language - Eye for detail - Flexible: available on the weekend - Everything you touch will sparkle and glowing 
 What can you expect from us? 
 - Gross salary of €13,42 per hour + 8% extra vacation money - Weekly payment - A nice and involved team - Nice extras, depends on your performance - Long-term employment - Always friendly consultant
